paragraphs.en: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs
paragraphs.zh: 用 Rust 编写的非官方 Bitwarden 兼容服务器，前身为 bitwarden_rs

paragraphs.en: An alternative server implementation of the Bitwarden Client API, written in Rust and compatible with official Bitwarden clients [ disclaimer ], perfect for self-hosted deployment where running the official resource-heavy service might not be ideal.
paragraphs.zh: Bitwarden 客户端 API 的另一种服务器实现，使用 Rust 编写，与官方 Bitwarden 客户端兼容 [ 免责声明 ]，非常适合自托管部署场景——在运行官方资源占用较高的服务可能并不理想的情况下尤为适用。

paragraphs.en: When using this server, please report any bugs or suggestions directly to us (see Get in touch ), regardless of whatever clients you are using (mobile, desktop, browser...). DO NOT use the official Bitwarden support channels.
paragraphs.zh: 在使用本服务器时，请将任何错误或建议直接反馈给我们（参见“联系我们”），无论您使用的是哪种客户端（移动端、桌面端、浏览器……）。 请勿使用 Bitwarden 官方支持渠道。

sents.en: When using this server, please report any bugs or suggestions directly to us (see Get in touch ), regardless of whatever clients you are using (mobile, desktop, browser...).
sents.zh: 在使用本服务器时，请将任何错误或建议直接反馈给我们（参见“联系我们”），无论您使用的是哪种客户端（移动端、桌面端、浏览器……）。

sents.en: DO NOT use the official Bitwarden support channels.
sents.zh: 请勿使用 Bitwarden 官方支持渠道。

paragraphs.en: A nearly complete implementation of the Bitwarden Client API is provided, including:
paragraphs.zh: 提供了一个几乎完整的 Bitwarden 客户端 API 实现，包括：

paragraphs.en: The web-vault requires the use of HTTPS and a secure context for the Web Crypto API . That means it will only work if you enable HTTPS . We also suggest to use a reverse proxy .
paragraphs.zh: Web 保险库（web-vault）需要使用 HTTPS 和安全上下文才能运行 Web Crypto API。 这意味着只有在你启用 HTTPS 的情况下它才能正常工作。 我们还建议使用反向代理。

sents.en: The web-vault requires the use of HTTPS and a secure context for the Web Crypto API .
sents.zh: Web 保险库（web-vault）需要使用 HTTPS 和安全上下文才能运行 Web Crypto API。

sents.en: That means it will only work if you enable HTTPS .
sents.zh: 这意味着只有在你启用 HTTPS 的情况下它才能正常工作。

sents.en: We also suggest to use a reverse proxy .
sents.zh: 我们还建议使用反向代理。

paragraphs.en: The recommended way to install and use Vaultwarden is via our container images which are published to ghcr.io , docker.io and quay.io . See which container image to use for an explanation of the provided tags.
paragraphs.zh: 安装和使用 Vaultwarden 的推荐方式是通过我们的容器镜像，这些镜像已发布到 ghcr.io、docker.io 和 quay.io。 请参阅「应使用哪个容器镜像」以了解所提供标签的说明。

sents.en: The recommended way to install and use Vaultwarden is via our container images which are published to ghcr.io , docker.io and quay.io .
sents.zh: 安装和使用 Vaultwarden 的推荐方式是通过我们的容器镜像，这些镜像已发布到 ghcr.io、docker.io 和 quay.io。

sents.en: See which container image to use for an explanation of the provided tags.
sents.zh: 请参阅「应使用哪个容器镜像」以了解所提供标签的说明。

paragraphs.en: There are also community driven packages which can be used, but those might be lagging behind the latest version or might deviate in the way Vaultwarden is configured, as described in our Wiki .
paragraphs.zh: 也有一些由社区维护的软件包可以使用，但这些软件包可能落后于最新版本，或者在 Vaultwarden 的配置方式上可能与我们 Wiki 中描述的有所偏差。

paragraphs.en: Alternatively, you can also build Vaultwarden yourself.
paragraphs.zh: 或者，您也可以自行构建 Vaultwarden。

paragraphs.en: While Vaultwarden is based upon the Rocket web framework which has built-in support for TLS our recommendation would be that you setup a reverse proxy (see proxy examples ).
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 Vaultwarden 基于 Rocket Web 框架，该框架内置了 TLS 支持，但我们建议你设置一个反向代理（参见代理示例）。

paragraphs.en: For more detailed examples on how to install, use and configure Vaultwarden you can check our Wiki .
paragraphs.zh: 有关如何安装、使用和配置 Vaultwarden 的更详细示例，您可以查看我们的 Wiki。

paragraphs.en: Pull the container image and mount a volume from the host for persistent storage. You can replace docker with podman if you prefer to use podman.
paragraphs.zh: 拉取容器镜像，并从主机挂载一个卷用于持久化存储。 如果你更倾向于使用 podman，可以将 docker 替换为 podman。

sents.en: Pull the container image and mount a volume from the host for persistent storage.
sents.zh: 拉取容器镜像，并从主机挂载一个卷用于持久化存储。

sents.en: You can replace docker with podman if you prefer to use podman.
sents.zh: 如果你更倾向于使用 podman，可以将 docker 替换为 podman。

paragraphs.en: docker pull vaultwarden/server:latest docker run --detach --name vaultwarden \ --env DOMAIN= " https://vw.domain.tld " \ --volume /vw-data/:/data/ \ --restart unless-stopped \ --publish 127.0.0.1:8000:80 \ vaultwarden/server:latest This will preserve any persistent data under /vw-data/ , you can adapt the path to whatever suits you.
paragraphs.zh: docker pull vaultwarden/server:latest docker run --detach --name vaultwarden \ --env DOMAIN= " https://vw.domain.tld " \ --volume /vw-data/:/data/ \ --restart unless-stopped \ --publish 127.0.0.1:8000:80 \ vaultwarden/server:latest 这将把所有持久化数据保存在 /vw-data/ 目录下，你可以根据需要自行调整该路径。

paragraphs.en: To use Docker compose you need to create a compose.yaml which will hold the configuration to run the Vaultwarden container.
paragraphs.zh: 要使用 Docker Compose，你需要创建一个 compose.yaml 文件，用于保存运行 Vaultwarden 容器的配置。

paragraphs.en: services : vaultwarden : image : vaultwarden/server:latest container_name : vaultwarden restart : unless-stopped environment : DOMAIN : " https://vw.domain.tld " volumes : - ./vw-data/:/data/ ports : - 127.0.0.1:8000:80 Get in touch Have a question, suggestion or need help? paragraphs.en: Encountered a bug or crash? Please search our issue tracker and discussions to see if it's already been reported. If not, please start a new discussion or create a new issue . Ensure you're using the latest version of Vaultwarden and there aren't any similar issues open or closed!
paragraphs.zh: 遇到了 bug 或崩溃？ 请先在我们的 issue 跟踪器和讨论区搜索，看看是否已有相关报告。 如果没有，请发起新的讨论或创建新的 issue。 请确保你使用的是最新版本的 Vaultwarden，并且没有类似的 issue 处于开启或关闭状态！

paragraphs.en: Thanks for your contribution to the project!
paragraphs.zh: 感谢你为该项目做出的贡献！

paragraphs.en: This project is not associated with Bitwarden or Bitwarden, Inc.
paragraphs.zh: 本项目与 Bitwarden 或 Bitwarden, Inc. 无任何关联。

paragraphs.en: However, one of the active maintainers for Vaultwarden is employed by Bitwarden and is allowed to contribute to the project on their own time. These contributions are independent of Bitwarden and are reviewed by other maintainers.
paragraphs.zh: 不过，Vaultwarden 的一位活跃维护者受雇于 Bitwarden，并被允许在个人时间内为该项目做贡献。 这些贡献是独立于 Bitwarden 的，并由其他维护者进行审核。

paragraphs.en: The maintainers work together to set the direction for the project, focusing on serving the self-hosting community, including individuals, families, and small organizations, while ensuring the project's sustainability.
paragraphs.zh: 维护者们共同为项目确定发展方向，专注于服务自托管社区，包括个人、家庭和小型组织，同时确保项目的可持续性。

We highly recommend performing regular backups of your files and database. However, should you experience data loss, we encourage you to contact us immediately.
paragraphs.zh: 请注意：对于使用 Vaultwarden 过程中可能出现的任何数据丢失，我们概不负责。 这包括密码、附件以及应用程序处理的其他信息。 我们强烈建议您定期备份文件和数据库。 不过，如果您遇到数据丢失，请立即联系我们。

paragraphs.en: This project was known as Bitwarden_RS and has been renamed to separate itself from the official Bitwarden server in the hopes of avoiding confusion and trademark/branding issues. Please see #1642 - v1.21.0 release and project rename to Vaultwarden for more explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 本项目原名为 Bitwarden_RS，后更名为 Vaultwarden，目的是与官方 Bitwarden 服务器区分开来，以避免混淆及商标/品牌方面的问题。 更多说明请参见 #1642 - v1.21.0 发布与项目更名为 Vaultwarden。
